modules.path: Twente Uni > CreaTe > Module 1 > ProfDev > Design Practice and Scrum Understanding
modules.title:
Design Practice
and Scrum Understanding
modules.focus: This module focuses on strengthening visual design practice through Illustrator and understanding structured teamwork through Scrum.
modules.whatIDid: I created Illustrator exercises such as a name combination graphic and a Christmas card, and I studied Scrum roles including Product Owner, Scrum Master, and Developer.
modules.keyResult: The result was a small set of design practice outputs together with a clearer understanding of how Scrum supports team-based work.
modules.whatILearned: I learned that Illustrator is useful for precise visual work such as logos, icons, posters, and other creative assets, and that Scrum helps teams through clear roles, sprint goals, and risk management.
modules.reflection: This module works best as a compact starting point that introduces both creative practice and structured collaboration.
modules.playHook: A simple design-completion puzzle or a Scrum-role matching interaction would fit this module well.
modules.outcomeDescription: Illustrator exercises and visual design practice results.

modules.path: Twente Uni > CreaTe > Module 2 > ProfDev > Proto Website Redesign
modules.title: Proto Website Redesign
modules.focus: This module focuses on redesigning the Proto website to improve usability while practicing UX and UI thinking and reflective design work.
modules.whatIDid: I analyzed the existing website, identified navigation pain points, proposed a Quick Access button, sketched ideas on paper, built Figma mockups, and refined them through committee feedback.
modules.keyResult: The main outcome was a set of Figma redesigns that communicated a clearer and more professional website direction, even though the implementation phase was delayed.
modules.whatILearned: I learned to balance creativity with practical usability, to keep design tools like Figma actively practiced, and to use iteration and feedback to improve decisions.
modules.reflection: I was proud of the design progress, but missed meetings, holidays, exams, and the lack of user data made the process slower and showed that better timeline buffers were needed.
modules.playHook: A UI rearrangement puzzle where the player fixes broken layout sections or selects the best usability improvements would match this module well.
modules.outcomeDescription: Proto website redesign mockups and UI improvement results.

modules.path: Twente Uni > CreaTe > Module 3 > ProfDev > BuildCV Idea Proposal
modules.title: BuildCV Idea Proposal
modules.focus: This module focuses on proposal writing and turning a vague business idea into a more structured and usable concept.
modules.whatIDid: I selected a CV platform idea, researched competitors and market trends, created a logo, and used strategic tools such as personas, SWOT, and 4P analysis.
modules.keyResult: The result was a BuildCV proposal with clearer structure, stronger visual identity, and a more practical plan for future development.
modules.whatILearned: I learned how to write more professionally in English, organize ideas through strategic frameworks, and turn short rough notes into a more complete proposal.
modules.reflection: Changing the challenge was frustrating at first, but it led to a more complete and useful result; the biggest lesson was that project scope must fit collaborators’ pace and deadline reality.
modules.playHook: A timed pitch-building game, keyword-combination challenge, or strategy-card matching mini game would connect naturally to this module.
modules.outcomeDescription: BuildCV proposal visuals, logo, and concept summary.

modules.path: Twente Uni > CreaTe > Module 4 > ProfDev > Rebuilding Portfolio Website with React
modules.title:
Rebuilding Portfolio Website
with React
modules.focus: This module focuses on rebuilding an old portfolio into a more modern, maintainable, and industry-aligned website using React.
modules.whatIDid: I reviewed problems in the old portfolio, collected references and feedback, reorganized project content, and rebuilt the website using React and Tailwind.
modules.keyResult: The result was a new portfolio with a cleaner layout, stronger structure, and a more professional presentation than the previous version.
modules.whatILearned: I learned React and Tailwind CSS, understood the value of user testing for UX, and improved my planning through a more structured workflow.
modules.reflection: I felt the new version looked clean and intuitive with strong performance, but language switching and mobile optimization still needed work.
modules.playHook: A reconstruction puzzle where portfolio blocks must be placed into the correct layout would reflect this module clearly.

modules.path: Twente Uni > CreaTe > Module 5 > ProfDev > Upgrading Rascal Cat for Release
modules.title: Upgrading Rascal Cat for Release
modules.focus: This module focuses on improving a game jam prototype into a more polished and publishable game with stronger systems and presentation.
modules.whatIDid: I reviewed player feedback, improved gameplay balance, added more objects, integrated a PlayFab leaderboard, and prepared the game for release on itch.io.
modules.keyResult: The result was a published version of Rascal Cat together with better game systems, release materials, and a clearer sense of full project completion.
modules.whatILearned: I learned more about the full game development lifecycle, how external services can support gameplay, and how feedback helps polish a game for real players.
modules.reflection: The project became much more complete and real, but WebGL support problems in the newer Unity version blocked browser play and showed I needed earlier platform research.
modules.playHook: A bug-catching game or a balancing mini game inspired by Rascal Cat’s stacking chaos would fit perfectly here.

modules.path: Twente Uni > CreaTe > Module 6 > ProfDev > Learning Python through Advent of Code
modules.title:
Learning Python
through Advent of Code
modules.focus: This module focuses on building coding confidence by learning Python through real problem-solving instead of only studying syntax.
modules.whatIDid: I analyzed job postings, chose Python as a useful language to improve, and practiced it through Advent of Code and daily problem-based learning.
modules.keyResult: The result was steady Advent of Code progress together with a clearer understanding of which coding foundations I still need to strengthen.
modules.whatILearned: I learned that solving real problems is more motivating than isolated grammar study, and that Python basics need to be supported by stronger algorithm knowledge.
modules.reflection: The challenge became much harder than expected, which shifted my goal from finishing everything to learning more deeply and realistically.
modules.playHook: A logic puzzle, code-order arrangement task, or simplified Advent-of-Code-style question would represent this module well.
modules.outcomeDescription: Advent of Code progress and coding result snapshot.

modules.path: Twente Uni > CreaTe > Module 7 > ProfDev > CV, Portfolio, and Job Market Preparation
modules.title:
CV, Portfolio,
and Job Market Preparation
modules.focus: This module focuses on preparing for internships and jobs by improving my CV, portfolio, and networking through real professional situations.
modules.whatIDid: I revised my CV through Overleaf and Figma, updated portfolio project pages in Notion, improved key portfolio sections, and visited the Business Fair.
modules.keyResult: The result was a finalized CV, an improved portfolio, and practical job preparation supported by real applications and company connections.
modules.whatILearned: I learned that feedback improves how clearly a CV presents me, that portfolio structure affects professional impression, and that networking gives useful application insights.
modules.reflection: I was proud that I completed almost everything on time and turned both the CV and portfolio into practical application tools, but I still wanted more feedback through a CV workshop and saw backend or admin tooling as the next improvement area.
modules.playHook: A CV-building or recruiter-match mini game, where the player chooses and arranges the right experience for a target company, matches this module very well.
modules.outcomeDescription: Final portfolio website and application-ready outcome.
